description: This file manages license handling within the Mattermost platform, including loading, validating, saving, and requesting trial licenses, as well as license-related logging and license manager configuration.

classes.name: JWTClaims
classes.description: Custom JWT claims structure including license ID and active users count, extending jwt.RegisteredClaims.

methods.name: LicenseManager
methods.description: Returns the current license manager interface.

methods.name: LoadLicense
methods.description: Loads and validates the license from environment variables, system store, or disk, and sets it if valid.

methods.name: SaveLicense
methods.description: Validates, unmarshals, and saves a license from bytes, updating system state and caches.

methods.name: SetLicense
methods.description: Sets or clears the current license, notifying listeners.

methods.name: ValidateAndSetLicenseBytes
methods.description: Validates license bytes and sets the license if valid.

methods.name: RemoveLicense
methods.description: Removes the current license and updates system state.

methods.name: AddLicenseListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for license changes.

methods.name: RemoveLicenseListener
methods.description: Removes a license change listener by ID.

methods.name: GetSanitizedClientLicense
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the client license.

methods.name: RequestTrialLicense
methods.description: Requests a trial license from the Mattermost license server and applies it.

methods.name: getRequestTrialURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL for requesting a trial license.

methods.name: logLicense
methods.description: Logs detailed license information for auditing.
